name: stripboard-optimiser-headless
description: Headless native stripboard solver, strict validation and standalone board/schematic SVG renderers

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p tests/solver/native/build && clang -O3 -DV5_EXPERIMENT_EDGE_MOUNT=1 -DV5_EXPERIMENT_FAST_GRID_CLEAR=1 -DV5_EXPERIMENT_FAST_IDENTICAL_GENOME=1 -fPIC -shared -o tests/solver/native/build/libv5decode.so components/stripboard/v5wasm/decode.c -lm && clang -O3 -fPIC -shared -o tests/solver/native/build/libv5route.so components/stripboard/v5wasm/route.c -lm && node tests/solver/native/buildAddon.js && mkdir -p tests/solver/native/build/edge tests/solver/native/build/fast && ln -sfn ../libv5decode.so tests/solver/native/build/edge/libv5decode.so && ln -sfn ../libv5decode.so tests/solver/native/build/fast/libv5decode.so
scripts.test:headless: npm run test:solver && npm run test:board
